request.user_text:
PRODUCTION: Project Nightfall (fictional). Base city: Mumbai, IN.
SCENE NUMBER: 42
KNOWN HEADING: EXT. MUMBAI ROOFTOP — SUNSET

SCENE INPUT:
EXT. MUMBAI ROOFTOP — SUNSET

A motorcycle tears across adjoining rooftops.
A drone follows while fireworks explode over the skyline.
Rain begins as the rider jumps to an adjacent building.

scene.heading: EXT. MUMBAI ROOFTOP — SUNSET
scene.synopsis: A motorcycle tears across adjoining rooftops. A drone follows while fireworks explode over the skyline. Rain begins as the rider jumps to an adjacent building.

requirements.description: Two structurally sound, adjoining flat rooftops in Mumbai capable of supporting a motorcycle, ramps, and crew.
Structural engineering assessment and reinforcement of the rooftops to safely handle the impact of the motorcycle jump.
requirements.source_ref: the rider jumps to an adjacent building

requirements.description: DGCA drone flight permits and local police clearance for operating a camera drone over urban Mumbai rooftops at sunset.
Professional stunt rider experienced in high-speed motorcycle jumps and wet-surface maneuvers.
requirements.source_ref: the rider jumps to an adjacent building

requirements.description: Pyrotechnics permit and clearance from Mumbai fire department for launching fireworks over the skyline.
SFX rain machines and overhead truss systems to simulate localized rain starting mid-scene without damaging electrical equipment.
Non-slip surface treatment applied to the motorcycle takeoff and landing zones to ensure traction when wet.
requirements.source_ref: Rain begins as the rider jumps

requirements.description: Strict scheduling to shoot during the limited 30-40 minute sunset window for matching skyline lighting.
Coordination with local neighborhood associations regarding noise control for the motorcycle engine and fireworks.
Rooftop edge protection, safety harnesses for crew, and specialized catch nets/airbags for the stunt jump gap.
